meta.title: Clean-sheet architecture decisions
meta.isolation: Derived only from task requirements; no repo source, ADRs, or prior architecture docs consulted

marking.FORCED: A named requirement or workload compels this choice (or its equivalence class)

decisions.decision: Primary domain object is a Finding (claim) paired with Evidence; Result aggregates findings, completeness, input identity, tool/rule identity
decisions.forcedBy: Prove the answer; checkable later (why); human reviewers need why
decisions.falsifiedBy: Users accept bare violation flags with no path to reconstruct reason from stored artifacts, or proof requires a live service

decisions.decision: Rules are first-class versioned declared inputs (identity + version/content hash + evaluation definition); built-ins use the same model
decisions.forcedBy: Rules they have declared; checkability against what inputs
rejected: Implicit floating linter defaults without identity
Rules as non-evaluable free text only
decisions.falsifiedBy: Runs with same claimed tool version disagree due to undeclared rule default changes, or baselines cannot pin rule set identity

decisions.decision: Findings have stable FindingKey identity separate from display location/message; key scheme is documented and versioned
decisions.forcedBy: Accept current state and gate only on what is new; mechanism trustworthy across tool upgrades
rejected: No key; full re-baseline every upgrade
decisions.falsifiedBy: Benign edits re-fire accepted issues as new, or real new violations hide under old keys after upgrades

decisions.decision: InputIdentity uses cryptographic content hashes of analysed bytes/trees; VCS revision labels are annotations only
decisions.forcedBy: Against what inputs; reproduce; offline
rejected: Network-fetched canonical source as required input
decisions.falsifiedBy: Different trees share identical input identity, or past results cannot be matched to recoverable inputs

decisions.decision: Completeness is first-class: in-scope, fully determined, skipped/failed/unsupported, and Undetermined with reasons
decisions.forcedBy: Report what could not be determined; CI must fail the build correctly; multi-language partial depth
decisions.falsifiedBy: Parse failure on a changed file yields exit 0 and empty findings with no undetermined record

decisions.decision: Analysis is a deterministic function of inputs, rule set, tool identity, and config; no LLM or probabilistic gate judgment
decisions.forcedBy: Calls no language models ever; determinism is credibility; offline; reproducible CI
rejected: Optional AI explain inside the tool
decisions.falsifiedBy: Same inputs/rules/tool/config produce different FindingKeys or completeness across runs

decisions.decision: One engine with two invocation shapes: Full (entire project) and Scoped (paths/changed-set/dependency closure); same finding model
decisions.forcedBy: AI agents: few-file edits, many rapid queries; CI: full one-shot; scale to 100k+ files
rejected: CI-only full scans with no scope
Separate unrelated products for agent vs CI
decisions.falsifiedBy: Scoped green systematically contradicts full red on same edits, or agents cannot answer without full-repo cost linear in repo size every query

decisions.decision: Scoped runs declare an explicit SoundnessClaim; partial scope must not claim global absence of violations
decisions.forcedBy: Prove/checkability combined with agent partial queries
rejected: Silent no-violations from path-limited runs without soundness boundary
Always expand every rule to whole program as the only option
decisions.falsifiedBy: Users treat scoped exit 0 as CI-equivalent full certification and the tool model encourages that

decisions.decision: Decompose analysis into pure units (discover → facts → rules → findings) with deterministic merge; exact stage names preferred not forced
decisions.forcedBy: Purity/determinism forced by D6; parallelisable units pressured by 100k+ CI scale (structure preferred)
rejected: Single-threaded monolithic walk as sole design
Shared mutable racing global analysis state
decisions.falsifiedBy: Parallel full analysis is nondeterministic, or 100k-file CI cannot complete without any unit decomposition/reuse path

decisions.decision: Full mode data-parallel with deterministic merge; interactive may cancel/supersede overlapping queries; no multi-tenant scheduler
decisions.forcedBy: CI scale (parallel preferred); many overlapping agent queries (supersede preferred); multi-tenant is non-goal
decisions.falsifiedBy: Overlapping agent queries deadlock or corrupt results, or parallel merge order changes findings set

decisions.decision: Optional content-addressed local fact cache; correctness must hold with cache disabled
decisions.forcedBy: Agent latency preferred; correctness without residency forced by CI no residency + offline reproducibility
rejected: Mandatory long-lived daemon for correct results
decisions.falsifiedBy: CI without cache disagrees with warm-cache agent results on same inputs/tool/rules

decisions.decision: Primary output is portable filesystem Result Artifact(s); hosted products import them; not required for gating
decisions.forcedBy: Offline; checkable later; hosted may consume never required; CI ephemeral
rejected: Cloud dashboard as only results store
decisions.falsifiedBy: Checking a past claim requires original process still running or a network account

decisions.decision: Evidence is mechanical: rule pin, locations, fact references, byte/path anchors; human message is projection not sole proof
decisions.forcedBy: Prove the answer; human why; no LLMs
decisions.falsifiedBy: Reviewer cannot re-derive claim from evidence + inputs + rules without guessing

decisions.decision: Artifact embeds reproduction pins: tool identity, rule set content hash, config hash, input hashes, invocation shape; pins imply byte-stable structured findings
decisions.forcedBy: Reproduce it; determinism; CI credibility
decisions.falsifiedBy: Following the recipe yields different FindingKeys or completeness

decisions.decision: Canonical result is structured machine-readable; human views are projections; exact codec (JSON/SARIF/etc.) is preferred not forced
decisions.forcedBy: Agents + CI need parseable outcomes; humans need why (capability forced; codec preferred)
rejected: Proprietary binary only with no dump tool
decisions.falsifiedBy: Agents cannot reliably parse outcomes, or humans cannot get why without a separate required product

decisions.decision: Baseline is an explicit set of accepted FindingKeys (with rule id and key-scheme version); gate fails on non-baselined keys subject to policy
decisions.forcedBy: Teams adopt with existing violations; gate only on what is new
rejected: Auto re-baseline on every tool upgrade
decisions.falsifiedBy: Brownfield teams cannot adopt without fixing all history, or new misses real regressions

decisions.decision: FindingKey scheme is versioned; upgrades that change keys require documented migration; silent remapping forbidden
decisions.forcedBy: Baselining trustworthy across tool upgrades
rejected: Auto-accept all newly detected keys on upgrade
decisions.falsifiedBy: After upgrade, accepted issues reappear as new without code change and without migration path, or real new issues are auto-swallowed

decisions.decision: Baseline is a local/reviewable artifact (VCS co-location preferred); no server required to trust it
decisions.forcedBy: Offline (serverless baseline forced); team reviewability (VCS co-location preferred)
rejected: Cloud-only baseline store as required path
decisions.falsifiedBy: Gating on only-new requires network to the vendor

decisions.decision: Distinguish detection-delta (tool/rules improved on same inputs) from code-delta (inputs changed); default CI treatment of detection-delta is preferred policy
decisions.forcedBy: Trust across tool upgrades (distinction forced; fail vs warn policy preferred)
rejected: Treat all new keys identically with no tool-vs-code classification
decisions.falsifiedBy: Operators cannot tell we regressed from analyzer improved after a version bump

decisions.decision: Emit first-class Undetermined records with subject, reason category, and gate treatment
decisions.forcedBy: Report what could not be determined; CI fail correctly
decisions.falsifiedBy: Incomplete runs look identical to complete clean runs in machine-readable output

decisions.decision: Default full CI policy: undetermined on in-scope code is non-zero exit (fail closed); overrides allowed and recorded
decisions.forcedBy: CI fail the build correctly (spirit supports fail closed; not uniquely forced); recording overrides forced by checkability
rejected: Always exit 0 if no violations ignoring incompleteness
decisions.falsifiedBy: Broken parser yields green CI by default with no trace in the artifact

decisions.decision: Primary deliverable is a local CLI run on laptop and CI; analysis completes in that trust boundary
decisions.forcedBy: Command-line tool; offline laptop; CI one-shot
decisions.falsifiedBy: Core analysis requires a vendor service call

decisions.decision: Ephemeral process is sufficient for correctness; optional local helper/daemon for cache warmth only
decisions.forcedBy: CI no residency forces ephemeral sufficiency; agent latency makes optional helper preferred
rejected: Architecture that cannot function without resident process
decisions.falsifiedBy: Documented CI path needs a standing daemon

decisions.decision: Hosted product is a pure consumer of Result Artifacts; never on critical path of offline gate decisions
decisions.forcedBy: Hosted may consume results but must never be required
decisions.falsifiedBy: Offline mode cannot produce a trustworthy gate decision

decisions.decision: Prefer self-contained native binary distribution; analysed-project runtimes are user-owned; deep engines bundled/pinned
decisions.forcedBy: Offline CI pin pressure; not uniquely forced packaging shape
rejected: Unpinned multi-toolchain install as only ship form
decisions.falsifiedBy: Install drift routinely changes analysis outcomes without tool version change

decisions.decision: Layered extension model: config → declarative rules → extractors → core runtime; third parties mainly rules/extractors; core retains gate integrity
decisions.forcedBy: Third parties may contribute (depth open); purity/no-LLM on certified path forced by determinism/offline
rejected: Arbitrary in-process scripts with full authority and no purity contract
Fully closed system as forced choice
decisions.falsifiedBy: Third-party rules change FindingKey semantics without scheme version, or extensions network during offline analysis

decisions.decision: Extensions on the gating path must be deterministic, pure-input, and offline; contract breaks exclude from certified mode or mark undetermined
decisions.forcedBy: Offline; no LLMs; determinism; checkability
rejected: Extensions may call network APIs for analysis context
decisions.falsifiedBy: Enabling a plugin makes CI unreproducible

decisions.decision: Third-party extractors/rules are opt-in, content-hash pinned in config, listed in Result artifact
decisions.forcedBy: Security judgment for opt-in; provenance in artifact forced by checkability
decisions.falsifiedBy: A result cannot list which extension code participated

decisions.decision: Exit status distinguishes clean complete, violations gate-fail, undetermined/incomplete, and tool error; exact numeric codes preferred
decisions.forcedBy: CI fail the build correctly; undetermined reporting; agent parsing (class separation forced; codes preferred)
rejected: Single non-zero for all failure modes
decisions.falsifiedBy: CI cannot separate violation fails from infra errors, or agents treat crashes as clean

decisions.decision: Policy maps immutable findings to GateDecision (baseline, severity, undetermined); policy params hashed into Result; baselined findings remain auditable
decisions.forcedBy: Accept current / only new; checkability of observation vs gate
rejected: Drop evidence for baselined findings entirely
decisions.falsifiedBy: Accepted findings disappear so thoroughly they cannot be audited

decisions.decision: Language tiering: deep / standard / surface; product commits to two deep languages; many languages at lower tiers
decisions.forcedBy: Supports many programming languages with genuinely deep analysis in two
rejected: Equal deep investment in all languages
decisions.falsifiedBy: Claims deep support where Completeness always marks semantic rules undetermined

decisions.decision: Deep languages: TypeScript (with JS surface) and Python
decisions.forcedBy: Requirements force count=2 and depth quality, not which pair; TS/Python guessed from typical AI-agent and CI estates
rejected: Treating any specific pair as forced by the prompt
decisions.falsifiedBy: Target users critical-path languages are neither TS nor Python and agent workload is mostly elsewhere

decisions.decision: Implement CLI runtime in a static-binary-friendly language (e.g. Rust or Go); deep engines embedded or pinned subprocesses recorded in Result
decisions.forcedBy: Offline CLI and determinism constrain packaging/pins, not host language choice
rejected: Unpinned PATH tools as sole deep engines
decisions.falsifiedBy: Host language prevents offline single-artifact distribution or forces nondeterministic runtimes for core gating

decisions.decision: Small common fact vocabulary plus language-specific extensions; avoid grand unified IR and avoid zero commonality
decisions.forcedBy: Multi-language + two deep; requirements do not force universal IR
rejected: Zero shared fact/evidence machinery per language
decisions.falsifiedBy: Common IR erases deep fidelity, or total split duplicates FindingKey/evidence bugs per language

decisions.decision: At 100k+ scale: stream unit results, shard by path/package, merge deterministically; avoid requiring whole monorepo in one RAM ball; whole-program graphs optional per rule
decisions.forcedBy: Scale hundreds to 100k+ files (pressure forced; tactics preferred; no hard memory SLO given)
rejected: Load all ASTs into one structure as only design
decisions.falsifiedBy: Fixed architecture OOM on large monorepos with no sharding path
